sql.dbFunction.getAll: select df.*, dft.function_type from flow.db_function df inner join flow.db_function_type dft on dft.id = df.db_function_type_id where df.archived is not true order by df.function_name
sql.dbFunction.getAvailableCompanies: select * from flow.company c where c.parent_company_id is not null and c.archived is false and not exists ( select cf.id from flow.company_function cf where db_function_id = :dbFunctionId and cf.company_id = c.id and cf.archived is false ) order by c.parent_company_id, c.company_name
sql.dbFunction.getTypes: select df.* from flow.db_function_type df where df.archived is not true order by df.function_type
sql.dbFunction.getParameterTypes: select pt.* from flow.parameter_type pt where pt.archived is not true order by pt.parameter_type
sql.dbFunction.archive: update flow.db_function set archived = true where id = :id
sql.dbFunction.getOne: select df.*, dt.data_type as return_data_type, dft.function_type, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(dbFunctionParams))) FROM ( select dfp.id, dfp.db_function_id as "dbFunctionId", dfp.display_order as "displayOrder", dfp.system_value_id as "systemValueId", sv.system_value as "systemValue", dfp.parameter_name as "parameterName", dfp.data_type_id as "dataTypeId", dfp.parameter_type_id as "parameterTypeId", pt.parameter_type as "parameterType", dt.data_type as "dataType" from flow.db_function_param dfp inner join flow.data_type dt on dfp.data_type_id = dt.id inner join flow.parameter_type pt on dfp.parameter_type_id = pt.id left join flow.system_value sv on sv.id = dfp.system_value_id where dfp.archived is not true and dfp.db_function_id = df.id order by display_order ) dbFunctionParams), '[]') AS "dbFunctionParams", coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(companyFunctions))) FROM ( select cf.id, cf.company_id as "companyId", cf.company_function_name as "companyFunctionName", c.company_name as "companyName" from flow.company_function cf inner join flow.company c on c.id = cf.company_id where cf.db_function_id = df.id and cf.archived is not true ) companyFunctions), '[]') AS "companyFunctions" from flow.db_function df left join flow.data_type dt on df.return_data_type_id = dt.id inner join flow.db_function_type dft on dft.id = df.db_function_type_id where df.id = :id
sql.dbFunction.insertFunction: insert into flow.db_function(function_name, return_data_type_id, db_function_type_id, display_name) values (:functionName, :returnDataTypeId, :dbFunctionTypeId, :displayName)
sql.dbFunction.insertParam: insert into flow.db_function_param(db_function_id, parameter_name, display_order, data_type_id, parameter_type_id, system_value_id) values(:dbFunctionId, :parameterName, (select coalesce(max(display_order) + 1, 0) from flow.db_function_param where db_function_id = :dbFunctionId), :dataTypeId, :parameterTypeId, :systemValueId)
